summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its existing Line of Credit Agreement with Monaco Investment Partners II, LP. The amendment extends the maturity date from May 31, 2027 to May 31, 2028 for the $3,000,000 line of credit. The Board of Directors and Audit Committee approved the amendment; the lender is controlled by director Donald P. Monaco. This is a routine debt modification with no change in principal amount, no special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring, and no strategic catalyst.
